name: SC Hot buttered rum batter
description: Smuggler's Cove's make-ahead spiced butter base for Hot Buttered Rum. Makes about 4 cups of batter, about 48 servings.
instructions: Use freshly ground cinnamon, nutmeg, and black pepper; ground cloves, allspice, and anise seed; salted butter; packed golden brown sugar; and Brer Rabbit Mild Molasses.
Combine the cinnamon, nutmeg, black pepper, cloves, allspice, and anise seed in a small bowl and set aside.
Melt the butter in a saucepan over low heat.
Add the sugar and stir. Add the molasses and vanilla extract and stir.

Finally, stir in the spice mixture. At first, as you stir to combine, the butter will form a separate layer. Continue to stir over low heat until all the ingredients combine, including the butter, about 15 minutes.
Remove from the heat. Let cool slightly.
While still warm and malleable, pour the batter into a storage container.
Let cool completely, then seal airtight, and store in the refrigerator where it will keep until the expiration date of the butter used to make it; note that date before you start the recipe.
When possible, it is always best to use fresh spices, but if you don't have a small pepper mill to grind the anise seeds, allspice, and black pepper, buy ground versions.
